title: Add cross-platform Windows test CI workflow using WSL
body:
<!--
        IMPORTANT:
        If you cannot understand or explain your work without using
        Artificial Intelligence (AI) then do not file here. Do not paste
        massive AI generated explanations. We accept the use of AI as long as
        it is digestible. Please explain your issues or improvements briefly
        and clearly in your own human voice.
-->
Initial attempt to finally revive my work from many years ago to run Windows library and tool tests against Linux test servers.

Work in progress, do not merge! Feedback and suggestions welcome, especially regarding individual failing tests.

Temporarily removes other GitHub CI workflows to improve CI performance during development.

-# Copyright (C) Daniel Stenberg, <daniel@haxx.se>, et al.

-
-name: 'AppVeyor Status Report'
-
-'on':
-  status
-
-concurrency:
-  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.sha }}-${{ github.event.target_url }}
-  cancel-in-progress: true
-
-permissions: {}
-
-jobs:
-  split:
-    name: 'split'
-    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
-    if: ${{ github.event.sender.login == 'appveyor[bot]' }}
-    permissions:
-      statuses: write  # To update build statuses
-    steps:
-      - name: 'Create individual AppVeyor build statuses'
-        if: ${{ github.event.sha && github.event.target_url }}
-        env:
-          APPVEYOR_COMMIT_SHA: ${{ github.event.sha }}
-          APPVEYOR_TARGET_URL: ${{ github.event.target_url }}
-          APPVEYOR_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.repository.full_name }}
-          DO_NOT_TRACK: '1'  # for gh
-          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
-        run: |
-          echo "${APPVEYOR_TARGET_URL}" | sed 's/\/project\//\/api\/projects\//' | xargs -t -n1 curl -s -- | \
-            jq -c '.build.jobs[] | {target_url: ($target_url + "/job/" + .jobId),
-                                    context: (.name | sub("^(Environment: )?"; "AppVeyor / ")),
-                                    state: (.status | sub("queued"; "pending")
-                                                    | sub("starting"; "pending")
-                                                    | sub("running"; "pending")
-                                                    | sub("failed"; "failure")
-                                                    | sub("cancelled"; "error")),
-                                    description: .status}' \
-                --arg target_url "${APPVEYOR_TARGET_URL}" | tee /dev/stderr | parallel --pipe -j 1 -N 1 \
-              gh api --silent --input - "repos/${APPVEYOR_REPOSITORY}/statuses/${APPVEYOR_COMMIT_SHA}"

+# Copyright (C) curl contributors

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: curl
+
+name: 'WSL'
+
+'on':
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - master
+      - '*/ci'
+    paths-ignore:
+      - '**/*.md'
+      - '.circleci/**'
+      - 'appveyor.*'
+      - 'Dockerfile'
+      - 'projects/**'
+  pull_request:
+    branches:
+      - master
+    paths-ignore:
+      - '**/*.md'
+      - '.circleci/**'
+      - 'appveyor.*'
+      - 'Dockerfile'
+      - 'projects/**'
+
+concurrency:
+  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+permissions: {}
+
+env:
+  CURL_CI: github
+  DO_NOT_TRACK: '1'
+
+jobs:
+  wsl-linuxsrv-wintool:
+    name: 'WSL Linux-servers + Windows-tool'
+    runs-on: windows-2022
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    defaults:
+      run:
+        shell: wsl-bash {0}
+
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: 'setup WSL'
+        uses: Vampire/setup-wsl@5fae231e29d976722de11654d8323419501bb327 # v7.0.0
+        with:
+          distribution: Ubuntu-24.04
+          additional-packages: >-
+            autoconf automake cmake gcc g++ libtool libssh2-1-dev make
+            mingw-w64 ninja-build pkgconf perl python3 python3-impacket
+            stunnel4 openssl openssh-client openssh-server nghttp2-proxy
+
+      - name: 'build Linux test infrastructure in WSL'
+        run: |
+          set -eux
+          cd "$(wslpath -a "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE")"
+          cmake -B bld-linux -G Ninja \
+            -DENABLE_DEBUG=ON \
+            -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
+            -DCURL_ZLIB=OFF -DCURL_BROTLI=OFF -DCURL_ZSTD=OFF \
+            -DCURL_USE_LIBPSL=OFF -DUSE_NGHTTP2=OFF \
+            -DCURL_DISABLE_LDAP=ON -DUSE_LIBIDN2=OFF -DENABLE_ARES=OFF
+          cmake --build bld-linux --target testdeps
+
+      - name: 'cross-build Windows curl/curlinfo in WSL'
+        run: |
+          set -eux
+          cd "$(wslpath -a "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE")"
+          cmake -B bld-windows -G Ninja \
+            -DCMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME=Windows \
+            -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc \
+            -DCMAKE_RC_COMPILER=x86_64-w64-mingw32-windres \
+            -DENABLE_DEBUG=ON \
